svg.title: Corpus pipeline and gates
svg.desc: The rebuild pre-flights the toolchain and the exact source PDF, extracts the corpus (page content, fix_text steps 0–5, unit segmentation, header detection, four post-passes), proves it character for character against the PDF, runs the golden suite, installs the corpus atomically, builds the SQLite tables and the FTS5 index, adds concepts, translations, variants and the v2 structural columns, the auxiliary indexes, the Insight Engine tables, the raag-timing and Nitnem layers, passes the integrity gate, installs the database atomically, writes the manifest and the content fingerprint. verify_regroup proves a corpus change touched only grouping; the data repository’s CI re-proves every pull request.

text.font-family: "Source Serif 4", Georgia, "Times New Roman", serif
ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, "Segoe UI", Roboto, Arial, sans-serif
